# Third-party repositories

`SOKE/` is an independent Git checkout of https://github.com/2000ZRL/SOKE.git,
branch `main`. It was moved from `/home/haipd/DexAvatar/data/SOKE` on 2026-11-03.
The old location is a compatibility symlink. Upstream source files are unchanged.

The checkout, environment and downloaded assets are excluded from the SLP Git
repository. To recreate the checkout: `git clone https://github.com/2000ZRL/SOKE.git third_party/SOKE`.
See `docs/soke_setup.md` for installation, validation, assets and limitations.
